title: Abstract iterative reduction bound
statement:
Let $m$ be a natural number and let $\ell_0,\dots,\ell_{m-1}$ be natural numbers (the layer sizes) whose sum is at most a positive integer $s$. Fix a real number $\varepsilon>0$, and suppose that $b_0,\dots,b_{m-1}$ are real numbers satisfying
\[
b_i \;\le\; \ell_i\cdot\left(\tfrac12\right)^{\log_2\!\left(2s/\varepsilon\right)}
\qquad\text{for every } i.
\]
Then $\sum_{i} b_i \le \varepsilon/2$.
replaced:
For $\sum_i \mathrm{layer\_size}(i)\le s$ with $0<s$ and $0<\varepsilon$, if each
per-stage bound satisfies
$\mathrm{per\_stage\_bound}(i)\le(\mathrm{layer\_size}(i))\cdot(1/2)^{\log_2(2s/\varepsilon)}$,
then $\sum_i \mathrm{per\_stage\_bound}(i)\le\varepsilon/2$. This packages the
union bound over all $d-2$ iterations as a purely arithmetic consequence of the
per-stage bounds.
